Example prompt: “Find 50 keyword ideas for [seed keyword] in [country], including related, similar, long-tail, and question-based keywords. Show search volume, CPC, competition, difficulty, and 6-month trend data. Group them by intent and highlight the top 10 opportunities for new content.”Spot recent changes in any domain’s search performance Get a quick view of organic and paid visibility, then dig into the keyword movements behind the biggest traffic gains and losses.   Example prompt: “Analyze recent search performance for [domain] in [country] over the last 30 days. Included in every plan. No code. No middleware.FAQAAn MCP server is a connector that lets AI assistants access external tools and data sources. SE Ranking MCP connects your AI assistant to live SE Ranking data (including keyword research, backlink analysis, website audits, domain analysis, and AI search visibility) so you can ask SEO and GEO questions in plain language and get data-backed answers.QDo I need a developer to set it up?ANo. SE Ranking MCP is hosted and managed by SE Ranking. You only need to add the MCP server URL to your AI client and authorize the connection. No local installation, Docker setup, or code required. The process usually takes under two minutes.QIs SE Ranking MCP included in my current plan?AYes. MCP access is included in every SE Ranking subscription. The amount of data you can pull depends on the API credits available in your pricing plan.QWhich AI tools does SE Ranking MCP support?ASE Ranking MCP works with AI tools that support MCP connections, including Claude Web, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Codex, Zed, Gemini CLI, and others.QWhat data is available through the MCP?ASE Ranking MCP gives your AI assistant access to 180+ SEO and GEO tools, including those for keyword research, domain analysis, backlink data, website audits, AI search visibility, and more.
